sources: https://www.pittks.org/visit/parks-recreation/facilities-rv-park/ (City of Pittsburg Parks & Recreation, page modified 2026-09-10), read 2026-11-06: 'Four Oaks RV Park'; 'Open Year Round'; '12 Drive Through Pavement Spaces'; 'Water Hydrant'; 'Electric (30 & 50 Amp)'; 'Dump site'; 'Showers/Restrooms – Open April 1 – Oct. 31'; 'Located Next to Four Oaks Golf Course and Lincoln Park at 721 W. 20th St.'; '(620) 231-8310'; 'RV Space Reservations: For reservations, please call the Parks and Recreation Office Monday – Friday: 8AM to 5PM at 620-231-8310'; 'Registration and full payment is required in advance for reservations'; 'RV Space Rental is $20 Per Day Per Space | 12 Spaces Available. | Check Out: 11AM'; 'Reserve An RV Space' (link to WebTrac); 'Cancellations may be made up to 7 business days before the reservation date.'
https://webtrac.pittks.org/webtrac/web/search.html?module=RN&type=RV (City of Pittsburg WebTrac 'RV Rental Search'), read 2026-11-06: 'Showing results 1-12 of 12'.
Esri World Imagery (37.4254,-94.71522 at 200 m), 2026-11-06: a paved lot of angled pull-through spaces on W. 20th St beside US-69 and the golf course; no water nearby.

values.note: Reserve online through the city's WebTrac RV rental page, or by phone with Parks and Recreation (Monday-Friday, 8 am-5 pm). Full payment is due at booking; cancel at least 7 business days ahead for a refund. Check-out 11 am.

booking.source: https://www.pittks.org/visit/parks-recreation/facilities-rv-park/ ('For reservations, please call the Parks and Recreation Office Monday – Friday: 8AM to 5PM at 620-231-8310'; 'Reserve An RV Space'; 'Check Out: 11AM'); WebTrac 'RV Rental Search ... 1-12 of 12', read 2026-11-06

values.note: The RV park is open all year; the showers and restrooms are open April 1 to October 31 only.

season.source: https://www.pittks.org/visit/parks-recreation/facilities-rv-park/ ('Open Year Round'; 'Showers/Restrooms – Open April 1 – Oct. 31'), read 2026-11-06

note: City of Pittsburg RV park on W. 20th St beside Four Oaks Golf Course and Lincoln Park: a paved lot of drive-through spaces. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 12 paved pull-throughs, 50 A, water, showers, dump, reservable, $20 a night (page modified 2026-09-10, read today). Changed: season is year-round (the Apr 1-Oct 31 dates are the shower house's, not the park's); booking via the city's WebTrac page or by phone; flush toilets added.
flags: Season correction: the derived opens 04-01 / closes 10-31 came from the shower-house dates. The city says 'Open Year Round'.
Rate dated: '$20 Per Day Per Space' on the city page (dateModified 2026-09-10), read 2026-11-06. Fees left as recorded (same figure).

Phone 620-231-8310 confirmed (Parks & Recreation). Website https://www.pittks.org/community/facilities/rv-park/ redirects to https://www.pittks.org/visit/parks-recreation/facilities-rv-park/; suggest storing the latter.
Not waterfront, confirmed (a paved lot by US-69). Pin fine. No sand issue.
